newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $3.7 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $3.7 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week are expected to total $3.7 billion in 115 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.9 billion in 45 sales, with a $316 million Palm Beach County, Fla., deal through Smith Barney topping the list.
On the competitive side, 70 sales totaling $1.8 billion are on the schedule, a $525 million California deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $407 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds next week, depending on market conditions.
